_about: The iOS app's paintings for the mysteries, the Seven Sorrows' card, the Prayer Book's pages and the Chant Library's sections and chants, as static WebP for the website (from ios app/Assets.xcassets; credits from ios Tools/ContentSourcing/manifest.json). An uploaded painting on the mystery or card wins over these. See docs/MYSTERY_PAINTINGS.md. Each painting also has a JPEG `<name>-preview.jpg` (at most 800 pixels wide) for link previews, which not every crawler reads as WebP.
